Thanks for looping us in. We can join Wed Aug 26 for the 45+15 split. A few procurement/security asks ahead of the call so we can move quickly: 
1) Please provide a copy of your SOC 2 Type II (or a redacted summary).
2) Any standard DPA you use (DocuSign link preferred) — we like to review before meeting.
3) Short allowlist instructions and expected source IPs for the test connection (even ephemeral ranges are fine).

You can drop the docs to this email or share a secure link. If you have a quick pre-demo checklist or a short runbook PDF (one page), that helps us triage who needs to attend.

If you’d like, we can run the procurement block with just procurement + security to accelerate decisioning while the SE team runs the demo.
